The updated screen is live. Refresh **http://maker:4001** and let's confirm the two refinements you asked for.

**Tag entry — the "pick or type" style.** On your saved card, click **Add tags & note** (or **Tags & note** if it already has some):

> **1.** Under **Your tags**, you'll see the tags you've already used as grey chips — click one to reuse it (it turns blue).
> **2.** To make a brand-new one, type it under **Add new** and press Enter.

**The private note with Markdown.** In the same panel:

> **3.** In the Note field, type something with a little formatting, for example:
> `**Key idea:** balance unit vs UI tests`
> then a new line: `- fast feedback`
> then: `- see [the article](https://martinfowler.com)`
> **4.** Click **Save**.

On the card, the note should now render that formatting — **Key idea:** in bold, a bullet list, and a clickable link — while staying your own private note.

Does the tag "pick or type" behaviour on the real card feel as good as it did in the comparison, and does the note formatting come out the way you'd expect?
